info.title: SmartCindy API
info.description: Authenticated native API. Responses are no-store. Unknown request fields are rejected. Memory/context and projects are owner-scoped; private retrieved content is never included in generation metadata. JSON bodies default to 16 KiB (8 KiB for account/auth, 256 KiB for turns); attachment/avatar bodies are capped at 8/2 MiB.

get.description: text/event-stream. after defaults to 0; Last-Event-ID may be used instead. If both are present they must agree. IDs increase contiguously; clients persist the last processed ID and deduplicate. Terminal replay ends; replay after terminal is empty. Heartbeat comments occur while waiting. Events: accepted {generation_id,user_message_id}; delta {text}; image {id,url,mime,width,height}; completed {status,result_message_id,usage}; failed {status,error}; cancelled {status,error}.

get.description: One-way SSE invalidation feed. Event data contains identifiers and actions only; fetch resource details through the authenticated APIs. No cursor or stale cursor produces a resync event at the current high watermark.

200.description: Server-sent resync or coalesced change events. Event IDs are owner-wide sequence numbers.

schema.description: SSE event stream. Data payloads match RealtimeResync or RealtimeChanges.

put.summary: Register or replace session-bound native push device
put.description: Full replacement for this owner/device ID. The registration binds to the current bearer session. An identical same-session PUT preserves the record and pending delivery. The push token is never returned. At most 32 devices per owner; token uniqueness is global. A registration bound to an expired session may be reclaimed.

email.description: Canonical locked account email; not changed by provider metadata refresh.

oneOf.description: Validated Google-hosted HTTPS picture URL; never fetched by the server.

push.description: At least one native push provider is configured.

request_id.description: Optional owner-scoped idempotency key. When supplied, it is fingerprinted with raw title and project_id.

CreateChat.description: Unknown fields are rejected. request_id is optional; an identical live replay returns the original chat, changed input conflicts, and a replay after deletion returns 410.

text.description: Combined text across parts is limited to 32 KiB UTF-8 bytes; maxLength alone counts characters.

parts.description: No more than four image parts; combined text is at most 32 KiB UTF-8 bytes. At least one nonempty text or image is required.

TurnRequest.description: Turn request. JSON body cap 256 KiB. Content, parts and context have additional semantic limits.

cached_input_tokens.description: Optional; omitted when the provider does not report a count.

uncached_input_tokens.description: Optional; omitted when the provider does not report a count.

token.description: 1..4096 UTF-8 bytes, no whitespace/control characters; iOS token must be hex.

previews.description: Opt in to a short assistant-reply or private generated-attachment preview.
